About.title: Lawyers who speak your language
About.paragraph1: LegalWin is a team of Polish attorneys (adwokat, radca prawny) and immigration consultants working with clients from Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Kazakhstan and the EU since 2019.
About.paragraph2: We handle cases at the Office for Foreigners, ZUS, tax authorities, KRS and courts. Our clients are entrepreneurs, IT professionals, investors and families relocating to Poland.
About.point1: Transparent pricing — fixed fee per stage
About.point4: Service in Polish, Russian, Ukrainian and English

Cases.title: Real cases, real timelines
Cases.subtitle: We show it raw: what, how fast, and with what outcome. Names changed at clients' request.

items.desc: First contact Friday — filing the next Friday. Mazowiecki voivodeship decided in 38 days vs standard 90.

items.desc: Two founders from Kazakhstan. S24, members' resolution, mBank account, VAT registration, contracts — done in a week.

items.title: Overturning a PR denial
items.desc: Client was denied PR on formal grounds. We filed a complaint to the Voivodeship Administrative Court — it quashed the denial, the voivode issued the card.

Process.title: Four steps to resolution
Process.step1Desc: 30–60 minutes free. We analyse the situation, assess chances, propose a strategy.
Process.step2Desc: We fix scope and fee in a written agreement. No surprises on the invoice.
Process.step3Desc: We prepare, file, represent. You get Telegram status updates at every stage.
Process.step4Desc: We secure the decision, hand over originals, explain next steps, reward repeat clients.

items.a: The first 30-minute consultation is free. For deep document review, follow-up sessions start at 200 PLN depending on complexity.

items.q: How long does a residence permit take?
items.a: Our average is 42 days. Statutory deadline is 90 days, but a clean filing with a full document pack gets decisions faster.
Yes. Clients from other Polish cities and abroad run cases fully online. Notarial power of attorney, a Telegram channel with the lawyer, and a client portal with live statuses.
We analyse the grounds and file an appeal within 14 days. We have successful appeals on TRC, PR, citizenship and international protection — including through the Voivodeship Administrative Court.

items.q: Can I register a company remotely?
items.a: Yes, via S24 with a qualified e-signature (ePUAP / ePodpis) or by notarial power of attorney. Registration takes 5–10 business days.

items.q: What languages do you work in?
items.a: Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, English. All documents come translated into your language.
